prompt: This is my Electron app (Sticky Notes Lite). I've never shipped anything on Windows. I'd like an MSIX installer for it. Please build it and install it on this machine the same way a user would, so I can find it in the Start menu and launch it.

reference.approach: Lay out Electron's runtime with the app under resources\app, generate a package manifest for the executable, pack it into an .msix, sign it with a certificate this machine trusts, and install the .msix file itself (not a loose-folder registration).

checks: installed-from-msix (required): it was installed from the package archive, not registered from a loose folder (IsDevelopmentMode is false)
msix-built (required): an .msix exists under the project folder (node_modules excluded)
msix-signed (required): it carries an Authenticode signature that still matches the file
msix-trusted: the signature chain is trusted on this machine
installed (required): a new package is installed whose install folder contains the Electron app (resources\app.asar or resources\app\package.json)
launches (required): activating the installed app starts its executable from the package
